newsitem.title: USA: Transkaryotic not profitable in Q3, Q4, 97.
newsitem.headline: Transkaryotic not profitable in Q3, Q4, 97.

text.p: Transkaryotic Therapies Inc said Wednesday it does not expect to be profitable in the third or fourth quarter, or its fiscal 1997 results, even though it was profitable in the second quarter.
The company reported a profit per share of of $0.02 compared to a loss of $0.32 for the same period a year ago. Revenues were $4.9 million compared to $137,000.
Revenues for the 1997 quarter included milestone payments of $4.5 million from Hoechst Marion Roussel Inc relating to it reaching development milestones in two collaborative programs.
The company did not provide details about why it does not expect to reach a profit in the rest of the year.
